All four source songs are from Powerful – EP (2019), whose originals carry NO located Lewis/17th Street credit — playlist the dub versions, not the Powerful originals.

Nothing from Hopes and Dreams, Easy To Love You, Let Love Lead, or Smile With The World qualifies — all documented to other producers (Scott Woodruff, E.N Young / Imperial Sound, Alific, BW, Nathan Aurora, and predominantly Johnny Cosmic).

Spirit Of The Light (album, Aug 29, 2025) — include only with the qualifier: '2 of 14 tracks recorded at 17th Street Studios, Costa Mesa; album mostly recorded at Great Stone Studios, Oakland; produced and mixed by Johnny Cosmic' — and flag that the second 17th Street track is unnamed in sources.

Fluid Foundation — 'The Rush' (feat. Kaleo Wassman of Pepper), Slo Ryde (2018) — via member. Pepper's own catalog: playlist core is EMPTY — no Pepper album, EP, or single carries a Lewis Richards / 17th Street credit in any source reviewed.
Holy Homework (album) — Lewis Richards among the printed producers; per-track scope unstated, include with that flag
